'''Docking berth 22''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located in [[Quantill City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. [[Koral-tae]] met a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team at the docking bay during their mission to investigate an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ando Project|operation]] on the world.<ref name="Ando">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>
